known_limitations: Fine-grained six-class application classification is not reliably generalized under outer tunnel encapsulation (Cloudflare WARP / WireGuard).
Outer tunnel padding and MTU multiplexing obscure subtle intra-family packet size distributions.
High-confidence predictions require selective threshold gating (tau >= 0.70) with conservative fallback to LOW_CONFIDENCE.
model_lightgbm_v1.recommended_use: Real-time encrypted traffic coarse-family monitoring (Bulk_Streaming vs Interactive) and selective intrusion detection with abstention in SOC environments.

known_limitations: Prone to step-discontinuity misclassifications on unseen network interface MTU boundaries.
Under-covers subtle interactive flows when packet counts are low (N < 5).
model_decision_tree_v1.recommended_use: Ultra-low latency embedded edge monitoring (< 0.003ms latency budget).

known_limitations: Increased tree traversal latency relative to single decision tree.
Ensemble voting variance under high VPN packet padding.
model_random_forest_v1.recommended_use: Secondary verification engine for coarse traffic anomaly detection.

known_limitations: Linear decision surface fails to capture non-linear inter-arrival timing dynamics.
Weakest individual macro-F1 across multi-class benchmarks.
model_logistic_regression_v1.recommended_use: Linear baseline verification and fast mathematical validation.
